aiResearchSummary.text: BedRock Systems is focused on enhancing security in virtualized environments. They are developing physical memory isolation techniques to ensure secure address space management in virtual systems. Their work on process credential protection aims to safeguard in-guest process credentials by binding them with specific values. Additionally, they are advancing a zero trust endpoint device featuring a formally verified microkernel, which is part of a trusted computing base with active security and policy enforcement. These efforts underscore their commitment to creating a secure computing base from edge to cloud.
